research_mode_notes.stochastic_scale_meaning: dependency_multiplier ~ max(0, N(1, 0.3)) per run; required for K(N) convergence analysis
research_mode_notes.duration_range: [5, 30] min — calibrated to avoid upper-tail ceiling saturation (0% saturation at this range)
research_mode_notes.deterministic_baseline: Use stochastic_scale=0.0 for reproducible unit-test runs
research_mode_notes.thesis_requirement: stochastic_scale must be stated explicitly in methodology section
